from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationRelation(BaseModel):
    """A directed citation link found in a paper's bibliography."""
    source_paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper that contains the bibliography (the citer)")
    target_paper_title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper listed in the bibliography (the cited)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all citation relations extracted from the document collection."""
    citation_relations: list[CitationRelation]
